comment: The flagged constructor only checks syntax and discards the RegExp object; it performs no text match. safePattern requires a nonempty string trimmed to at most160characters, rejects newline/NUL and selected unsupported constructs, and rejects invalid syntax. These heuristics are not a proof of safe backtracking. Actual validateSignalXml consumer validates the definition before validateDynamicContract, which establishes a shared100ms deadline across at most30additional fields. validateAdditionalFieldText rejects exhausted remaining time and executes the dynamic expression only through safeRegexTest and vm.runInContext timeout. Timeout/failure becomes SignalValidationError, not acceptance; nonmatch also rejects. XML is capped at64KiB. Independently rerun pathological and compatibility tests confirm bounded rejection. The generic constructor warning omits this bounded execution boundary.
